**Introduction**
Als Senior
**Customer Success Manager (m/w/d)**
übernimmst Du bei FactFinder ein eigenes Portfolio namhafter eCommerce-Kunden und verantwortest deren Entwicklung von Adoption und Value Realization bis zu Renewal und Expansion.
Dabei arbeitest Du mit anspruchsvollen Mid-Market-, Enterprise- und Strategic Accounts – B2B- wie B2C-Unternehmen aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen – und bewegst Dich souverän zwischen operativen eCommerce-Teams, technischen Ansprechpartnern und C-Level-Stakeholdern.
FactFinder ist eine der führenden Product-Discovery-Plattformen für den europäischen eCommerce. Über 2.000 Kunden wie Douglas und SPAR erzielen mit unserer KI-gestützten Produktsuche einen Gesamt-GMV von mehr als 160 Milliarden Euro pro Jahr.
**Auf einen Blick**
Kundenportfolio: ca. 40–50 Accounts – überwiegend Mid-Market, ergänzt um Enterprise- und Strategic Accounts, vorwiegend im DACH-Markt
Kommerzielle Verantwortung: Upsell- und Expansion-Ziele sowie Churn-Prävention und Vermeidung von Downgrades – die kommerzielle Ownership liegt bei Dir als CSM
Standorte: Berlin, München oder Pforzheim – hybrid mit 2–3 Office-Tagen pro Woche
Team & Reporting: CS-Team mit klar definierten Senioritätsleveln, Reporting an die Director Customer Success
Über FactFinderSeit über 20 Jahren entwickelt FactFinder KI- und Machine-Learning-Technologie für Produktsuche, Navigation, Personalisierung und Produktempfehlungen im Online-Handel. Mit unserer Product Discovery Experience (PDX), dem Investor Genui im Rücken und einem neuen Management-Team starten wir in die nächste Wachstumsphase. Rund 90 Kolleginnen und Kollegen arbeiten an unseren Standorten in Pforzheim, Berlin, München und Stockholm.
**Your mission**
Portfolio & Customer Value: Du verantwortest ca. 40–50 Mid-Market-, Enterprise- und Strategic Accounts, überwiegend im DACH-Markt – B2B- und B2C-Kunden aus den unterschiedlichsten Branchen, was die Rolle besonders abwechslungsreich macht. Gemeinsam mit Deinen Kunden definierst Du klare Ziele und Success-Pläne und machst den Mehrwert von FactFinder anhand relevanter KPIs messbar.
Retention & Churn-Prävention: Du erkennst anhand von Produktnutzung, Adoption und Kundenfeedback frühzeitig Risiken und leitest proaktiv Maßnahmen ein. Die kommerzielle Renewal-Verantwortung liegt bei Dir – mit starker Unterstützung durch unser Sales Operations Team. Da sich unsere Verträge in der Regel automatisch verlängern, liegt Dein Fokus auf Churn-Prävention und der Vermeidung von Downgrades.
Upsell & Expansion: Du verantwortest Expansion in Deinem Portfolio end-to-end – von der Identifikation der Opportunity bis zum kommerziellen Abschluss, aktuell punktuell noch mit Unterstützung durch Sales. Du hast ein eigenes, portfolioabhängiges Expansion-Ziel, das direkt in Deinen variablen Anteil einfließt.

Voice of the Customer: Du verstehst Herausforderungen und Anforderungen Deiner Kunden und übersetzt sie in klare Impulse für Product und Product Marketing. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit Sales, Consulting und Support zusammen.

Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Betreuung anspruchsvoller B2B-SaaS-Kunden im Customer Success, Account Management oder einem kundenorientierten SaaS-, Digital- oder Technology-Consulting-Umfeld.Erfahrung mit Mid-Market- und/oder Enterprise-Kunden und komplexen Stakeholder-Strukturen bis zur C-Level-Ebene.Technisches

jobs.description:
DO YOU HAVE HANDS-ON DEMAND PLANNING AND FORECASTING EXPERIENCE?

The Wheel Group is hiring a Demand Planning Analyst to own SKU-level forecasting, maintain an 18-month rolling demand forecast, and help ensure the right inventory is in the right place at the right time across multiple distribution locations.

This is a hands-on forecasting role requiring direct experience building and maintaining demand forecasts, analyzing historical sales, seasonality, promotions, and new product launches, and measuring forecast accuracy using metrics such as MAPE/WMAPE and forecast bias.

WHAT DRIVES US

Founded in 1997, The Wheel Group is a leading designer, developer, and owner of aftermarket automotive wheel, tire, and accessory brands, with a focus on quality, innovation, and performance. Headquartered in Ontario, California, with 15 distribution centers throughout the U.S. and Canada as well as a QC, engineering and support services office in Shanghai, China, TWG serves a diverse base of customers across North America and globally.

TAKING THE WHEEL

We are seeking a Demand Planning Analyst to drive SKU-level forecasting and inventory planning across our growing automotive aftermarket business. This role will own and maintain an 18-month rolling demand forecast, analyzing historical sales, seasonality, promotions, new product launches, and demand trends to ensure the right inventory is available across our multi-warehouse distribution network.

You will work cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Finance through the monthly S&OP process, monitor forecast accuracy and bias, and turn demand insights into actionable inventory plans that support growth and service-level targets.

HOW YOU'LL SHAPE THE FORECAST

Develop and maintain SKU-level forecasts across product categories, regions, and channels.
Manage an 18-month rolling forecast incorporating historical data, seasonality (e.g., winter/summer demand), promotions, and product lifecycle.
Adjust forecasts for fitment-driven demand variability and new product launches.
Participate in monthly S&OP to align demand, supply, and financial plans.
Partner with Sales and Marketing to capture market intelligence and promotional impact.
Provide data-driven recommendations and challenge assumptions.
Analyze demand trends, seasonality, and regional/locations performance.
Track forecast accuracy (MAPE/WMAPE), bias, and service metrics.
Deliver regular reports and dashboards to support decision-making.
Improve forecasting models, tools, sales consensus and planning processes.
Support optimization of demand planning systems and reporting automation.

WHAT'S IN YOUR PLANNING TOOLBOX

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Business, or related field.
5+ years in demand planning or supply chain planning experience.
Automotive aftermarket or CPG experience preferred.
Experience managing large SKU portfolios and multi-location networks.
Advanced Excel Formula (Power Query/Power Pivot).
Experience with ERP/planning systems
Familiarity with Power BI or similar tools.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Effective cross-functional communication and collaboration.
Detail-oriented with ability to manage multiple priorities.
Success Metrics
Forecast Accuracy (MAPE / WMAPE)
Service Level / Fill Rate
Inventory Turns & Working Capital
Reduction in Excess & Obsolete Inventory

based at The Wheel Group’s headquarters in Ontario, California
. This role is not remote or hybrid.

VARITE is looking for a qualified  Compliance Consultant, Senior 
for one of its clients located in Oakland, CA.  

WHAT THE CLIENT DOES? 

A major utility company that provides electricity and natural gas services to millions of customers. It operates a vast energy infrastructure, including power plants, transmission lines, and gas pipelines.

WHAT WE DO? 

Established in the Year 2000, VARITE is an award-winning minority business enterprise providing global consulting & staffing services to Fortune 1000 companies and government agencies. With 850+ global consultants, VARITE is committed to delivering excellence to its customers by leveraging its global experience and expertise in providing comprehensive scientific, engineering, technical, and non-technical staff augmentation and talent acquisition services. 
HERE'S WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

Position Description

You will provide strategic and tactical guidance on enhancing the development, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of various foundational elements within client’s compliance program framework. You will apply deep technical knowledge of compliance, risk management, and quality assurance to ensure consistent interpretation and application of compliance program maturity standards across Electric Compliance sub-functions and key partner teams. You partner closely with Electric leaders to evaluate compliance maturity performance, perform gap analyses to identify gaps and develop mitigation plans. You lead key compliance management workstreams that enable Electric coworkers to conduct business in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and standards, and to identify, manage, and mitigate risk. You will help strengthen Electric’s compliance program by guiding program development, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Provide strategic guidance, coaching, and hands-on support to Electric sub-functions to strengthen and mature the compliance program and improve performance;
Develop innovative tools and solutions to support/improve compliance program maturity
Assess Electric sub-function compliance programs;
Perform compliance validation activities and testing controls for design and operating effectiveness;
Supports the development and implementation of Electric’s Compliance Controls Program by providing expert advisory support to cross-functional partners (operations, engineering, SMEs, compliance support teams) to strengthen controls, evidence capture, process consistency, and develop compliance metrics;
Leads or supports maintaining a complete and accurate inventory of regulatory requirements, including identifying requirement owners, and mapping requirement to guidance documents, controls, and trainings;
Performs and oversees analysis of compliance metrics, evidence, and documentation to identify gaps, trends, and areas for improvement;
Develops and/or supports maintenance of guidance documents, procedures, templates, and job aids that support compliance maturity;
Identifies new or changing regulatory, operational, or risk concerns that may impact maturity expectations and recommends updates to programs or tools;
Conducts and supports compliance reviews with Electric sub-function leaders, facilitating compliance assessments and recommending corrective actions aligned to regulatory requirements and risk priorities;
Prepares and delivers clear, executive-ready reports and briefings on compliance maturity performance, risks, and opportunities for improvement;
Serves as a subject matter expert on compliance program maturity practices, supporting knowledge sharing/benchmarking across the organization;
Evaluate and analyze regulatory requirement and internal commitment challenges to determine extent of condition and remediation efforts;
Develop and present program challenges and program improvement recommendations to directors and officers;
Works independently with minimal guidance on complex risk and compliance issues with critical impact;
Develops and coordinates preparation of presentation materials for various levels of management up to and including senior vice president;
Leads and develops materials for training and educating coworkers about compliance management principles; and
Assist with other compliance-related projects and activities as directed.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO WIN: 

TOP THINGS LOOKING FOR:

(1) Problem-solving: Analyzing complex issues, identifying root causes, and developing and implementing effective solutions;
(2) Critical thinking: Evaluating information, distinguishing between valuable requirements and lower priorities, and thinking logically to analyze data thoroughly; and
(3) Strategic Thinking & Planning: The ability to see the "big picture" and ensure all projects within the program map directly to organizational goals.

TOP SKILL SETS LOOKING FOR:

(1) Proven ability to design and lead implementation of compliance governance models that drive operational alignment and accountability;
(2) Strong understanding of utility operations and asset management, with the ability to translate regulatory expectations into field-executable strategy; and
(3) Demonstrated success leading cross-functional, high-impact initiatives through risk-based planning, change leadership, and strategic execution.

Education
: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
Experience
: 5+ years of related experience or equivalent with steady progression of responsibilities

Desired
Master’s degree in engineering, economics, business administration or job-related field
Proven ability to design and lead implementation of compliance governance models that drive operational alignment and accountability
Strong understanding of utility operations and asset management, with the ability to translate regulatory expectations into field-executable strategy
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional, high-impact initiatives through risk-based planning, change leadership, and strategic execution
Executive communication skills and presence, with experience delivering high-impact presentations and updates to senior leadership and external stakeholders
Ability to align compliance strategy with enterprise goals, influencing direction across functions through collaboration, insight, and strategic clarity
Strong problem-solving, project/change management, and communication skills
Deep knowledge of utility regulatory frameworks (e.g., CPUC, FERC, NERC, WECC) and how they inform enterprise compliance strategy
Proven ability to design and lead implementation of compliance governance models that drive operational alignment and accountability

VARITE is looking for a qualified  Compliance Consultant, Senior 
for one of its clients located in Oakland, CA.  

WHAT THE CLIENT DOES? 

A major utility company that provides electricity and natural gas services to millions of customers. It operates a vast energy infrastructure, including power plants, transmission lines, and gas pipelines.

WHAT WE DO? 

Established in the Year 2000, VARITE is an award-winning minority business enterprise providing global consulting & staffing services to Fortune 1000 companies and government agencies. With 850+ global consultants, VARITE is committed to delivering excellence to its customers by leveraging its global experience and expertise in providing comprehensive scientific, engineering, technical, and non-technical staff augmentation and talent acquisition services. 
HERE'S WHAT YOU’LL DO: 

Position Description

You will provide strategic and tactical guidance on enhancing the development, implementation, monitoring, and continuous improvement of various foundational elements within client’s compliance program framework. You will apply deep technical knowledge of compliance, risk management, and quality assurance to ensure consistent interpretation and application of compliance program maturity standards across Electric Compliance sub-functions and key partner teams. You partner closely with Electric leaders to evaluate compliance maturity performance, perform gap analyses to identify gaps and develop mitigation plans. You lead key compliance management workstreams that enable Electric coworkers to conduct business in compliance with applicable laws, regulations, and standards, and to identify, manage, and mitigate risk. You will help strengthen Electric’s compliance program by guiding program development, monitoring, and continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Provide strategic guidance, coaching, and hands-on support to Electric sub-functions to strengthen and mature the compliance program and improve performance;
Develop innovative tools and solutions to support/improve compliance program maturity
Assess Electric sub-function compliance programs;
Perform compliance validation activities and testing controls for design and operating effectiveness;
Supports the development and implementation of Electric’s Compliance Controls Program by providing expert advisory support to cross-functional partners (operations, engineering, SMEs, compliance support teams) to strengthen controls, evidence capture, process consistency, and develop compliance metrics;
Leads or supports maintaining a complete and accurate inventory of regulatory requirements, including identifying requirement owners, and mapping requirement to guidance documents, controls, and trainings;
Performs and oversees analysis of compliance metrics, evidence, and documentation to identify gaps, trends, and areas for improvement;
Develops and/or supports maintenance of guidance documents, procedures, templates, and job aids that support compliance maturity;
Identifies new or changing regulatory, operational, or risk concerns that may impact maturity expectations and recommends updates to programs or tools;
Conducts and supports compliance reviews with Electric sub-function leaders, facilitating compliance assessments and recommending corrective actions aligned to regulatory requirements and risk priorities;
Prepares and delivers clear, executive-ready reports and briefings on compliance maturity performance, risks, and opportunities for improvement;
Serves as a subject matter expert on compliance program maturity practices, supporting knowledge sharing/benchmarking across the organization;
Evaluate and analyze regulatory requirement and internal commitment challenges to determine extent of condition and remediation efforts;
Develop and present program challenges and program improvement recommendations to directors and officers;
Works independently with minimal guidance on complex risk and compliance issues with critical impact;
Develops and coordinates preparation of presentation materials for various levels of management up to and including senior vice president;
Leads and develops materials for training and educating coworkers about compliance management principles; and
Assist with other compliance-related projects and activities as directed.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO WIN: 

TOP THINGS LOOKING FOR:

(1) Problem-solving: Analyzing complex issues, identifying root causes, and developing and implementing effective solutions;
(2) Critical thinking: Evaluating information, distinguishing between valuable requirements and lower priorities, and thinking logically to analyze data thoroughly; and
(3) Strategic Thinking & Planning: The ability to see the "big picture" and ensure all projects within the program map directly to organizational goals.

TOP SKILL SETS LOOKING FOR:

(1) Proven ability to design and lead implementation of compliance governance models that drive operational alignment and accountability;
(2) Strong understanding of utility operations and asset management, with the ability to translate regulatory expectations into field-executable strategy; and
(3) Demonstrated success leading cross-functional, high-impact initiatives through risk-based planning, change leadership, and strategic execution.

Education
: Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
Experience
: 5+ years of related experience or equivalent with steady progression of responsibilities

Desired
Master’s degree in engineering, economics, business administration or job-related field
Proven ability to design and lead implementation of compliance governance models that drive operational alignment and accountability
Strong understanding of utility operations and asset management, with the ability to translate regulatory expectations into field-executable strategy
Demonstrated success leading cross-functional, high-impact initiatives through risk-based planning, change leadership, and strategic execution
Executive communication skills and presence, with experience delivering high-impact presentations and updates to senior leadership and external stakeholders
Ability to align compliance strategy with enterprise goals, influencing direction across functions through collaboration, insight, and strategic clarity
Strong problem-solving, project/change management, and communication skills
Deep knowledge of utility regulatory frameworks (e.g., CPUC, FERC, NERC, WECC) and how they inform enterprise compliance strategy
Proven ability to design and lead implementation of compliance governance models that drive operational alignment and accountability
